requirements.description: The user explicitly requires a minimum gross floor area of 850 sqm. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied. Energy class and proximity to public transport are not reference columns and are not extracted. The 'Turin' location is handled by the Location Agent, not comune_code.

The user prefers properties near public transport (metro, bus, stations). 'Near' indicates a proximity need, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71). Building requirements (850 sqm minimum area, 60-person capacity, energy class C or better) and the office typology are excluded because they are not proximity services.

User prefers an energy class of C or better. Maps to all classes from C upward (A1-A4, B, C). Preference only; it is evaluated in ranking. Area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), public transport proximity and location in Turin are outside the available columns and are not filtered here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates, energy class A1–C, and mobility score >= 71. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the supplied coordinates. No comune_code predicate is applied, since the place name is not a cadastral code.
